The first plot, labeled as A, illustrates the average number of days with precipitation per year over a period from 2008 to 2021. The x-axis, labeled as "Годины" (Years), is a linear scale with a value range from 2008 to 2021, marked at yearly intervals. The y-axis, labeled as "Среднее количество дней" (Average number of days), is also a linear scale with a value range from 200 to 280 days, marked at intervals of 20 days. The line in plot A is red, with a solid line style, and it shows a decreasing trend in the average number of days with precipitation, starting at approximately 280 days in 2008 and ending at around 200 days in 2021. The line has data points marked at each year, with the highest point at the start and the lowest at the end of the x-axis.

The second plot, labeled as B, represents the percentage of defective products over the same time period. The x-axis, labeled as "Годины" (Years), is a linear scale with a value range from 2008 to 2021, marked at yearly intervals. The y-axis, labeled as "Структурен процент дефектов" (Structural percentage of defects), is a linear scale with a value range from 0.0% to 2.0%, marked at intervals of 0.5%. The line in plot B is red, with a solid line style, and it shows a V-shaped trend, with the percentage of defects decreasing from around 2.0% in 2008 to approximately 0.5% in 2017, and then increasing to about 2.0% in 2021. The line has data points marked at each year, with the lowest point at the center of the x-axis and the highest points at the start and end of the x-axis.
